spans.s:
Ciccika is a bird mentioned with the equally unknown vṛṣārava in one hymn of the Rigveda. It may perhaps be compared with the Ciṭaka mentioned by Dārila in his commentary on the kauśika sūtra.
Foot notes x. 146, 2.
xxvi. 20; Bloomfield, Hymns of the Atharvaveda, 266.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 90; Griffith, Hymns of the Rigveda, 2, 589.
